notes.title: Regular Update
notes.content:
- Added new level with boss enemy, new level can be entered from the new portal on the sky town map.
- Added traps and other interactive objects, traps can dismember both the protagonist and the enemies.
- Added non controllable dragons which will be controllable after next update.

- 添加了新地图和新的精英敌人，可以从天空之城地图上添加的传送门进入新地图。
- 添加了陷阱和其它可互动的物品，陷阱可以肢解主角和敌人。
- 添加了不可控制的龙，下次更新后将可以控制。

The update has changed the Direct X version from DX11 to DX12 for better performance on most common hardware.
The DX11 version before the update is also available as different branch:
Launch the Steam Client.
Go to the LIBRARY tab.
Right-click on Seductress and select Properties.
Then click the Betas tab.
Then select "DX11 version" from the Beta Participation drop-down and close the window.
Then the game would be reversed to the DX11 version.
To change back to the default version select "None" from the drop-down and close the window.

这次的更新已将 Direct X 版本从 DX11 更改为 DX12，在大多数常见硬件上获得更好的性能。
可以选择恢复到更新前的 DX11 版本：
启动 Steam 客户端。
切换到 库LIBRARY 选项卡。
右键单击游戏并选择属性。
然后单击 测试版Betas 选项卡。
然后在 参与测试BetaParticipation 下拉菜单中选择“DX11 version”并关闭窗口。
然后游戏将恢复为 DX11 版本。
要更改回默认版本，请从下拉菜单中选择“无”并关闭窗口。

There's another new map going to be uploaded later, then the current version won't receive updates until it's replaced by the remastered version. The development has been switched to the remastered version of the game, which is made with much better framework and much more expensive plugins, but I also replaced lots of modules of the framework and added my own code modules e.g. the character customization, the body dismemberment feature etc. from the current version of the game.
Players will be able to build their bases with the remastered version, and the monsters are going to raid the player bases. The new combat mechanism would be more exciting and would support quick switching to any weapon or special ability from the hotbar, also would try to implement even more interesting mechanism to slice the protagonist from any angle, and the result would be the ability for the enemies to freely cut the body into any shapes.
New branch for the remastered version would be available after next month, it'll become the default branch of the game when it's stable enough, and the enhanced character customization as suggested will be added to the new version.

notes.title: Hotfix V0.11
notes.content:
Hotfix V0.11

- Fixed crash caused by infinite loop from quest system after killing any orc
- Fixed crash caused by dividing by zero from the character level up formular
- Fixed companion occasionally keeps blocking after combat
- Fixed duplicated blocking effects when NPC has blocked enemy attacks
- Added portal to the orc base map, the portal is spawned after killing the ogre located inside the orc base.
- Adjusted the camera when performing some of the sprint attacks
- Changed the character respawn location to be near the corpse and the respawned character automatically loads the learned spells and picked items from the most recent save file.
- Fixed the learnt spells and recruited companions not loaded after player character respawns and then teleports to another map.
- Esc key can be used to close the inventory window or open the pause menu.
- Added map textures to the map UI.
- Changed some quests and added quest markers to the maps.
- Completed the Chinese translation for the menus.

- 修复杀死任意兽人后任务系统无限循环导致的崩溃。
- 修复角色升级公式除以零导致的崩溃。
- 修复同伴在战斗后偶尔会持续格挡状态的问题。
- 修复NPC格挡敌人攻击时格挡效果重复的问题。
- 兽人基地地图添加传送门，杀死兽人基地内的食人魔后会出现传送门。
- 调整某些攻击动画的相机角度。
- 修改角色的复活位置，复活的角色的物品栏会自动读取最近载入过的存档。
- 修复角色复活后传送到另一个地图时未加载学到的法术和招募的同伴的问题。
- Esc键可用于关闭物品窗口或打开暂停菜单。
- 地图UI界面更换了新的贴图。
- 更改了一些任务并在地图上添加了任务标记。
- 补充了一些菜单的中文翻译。
